subject: Integration proposal: ToolingWorks + Redwood toolchain adapter
messages:
From: Ethan Zhou <ethan@toolingworks.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Integration proposal: ToolingWorks + Redwood toolchain adapter

Hi Jordan & Marissa,

Hope you’re both well — I’m Ethan (Head of Partnerships at ToolingWorks). We build a developer toolchain for prompt orchestration, tracing, and model-switching that complements inference providers. We’ve had a few customers ask for a first-class Redwood adapter so they can route runtime calls and trace context through a single pipeline.

Quick ask: could we set a 30–45m intro next week to walk through a proposed integration approach? High-level thoughts: 
- SDK adapter that translates LW SDK calls to Redwood’s API (server and client)
- Trace propagation support (OpenTelemetry + mapping to Redwood request IDs)
- Example app + sandbox keys for testing

Attached: ToolingWorks-Product-Brief.pdf (2pp) and a short PoC scope doc.

If you’re the right folks, I can include engineering leads and our security contact (Asha Patel) on follow-ups.

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Zhou
Head of Partnerships, ToolingWorks
ethan@toolingworks.com
Attachments: ToolingWorks-Product-Brief.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Zhou <ethan@toolingworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration proposal: ToolingWorks + Redwood toolchain adapter

Ethan — thanks for the note and the brief. Really appreciate the concise scope. We’re interested in exploring this — Redwood has been seeing more requests for turnkey tracing+adapter integrations, and this could be a useful partner offering.

Proposed next steps:
1) Kickoff/intro call (30m) — propose Tue 13 Jul, 10:00am PT or Wed 14 Jul, 2:00pm PT.
2) Asha (security) — please share SOC2 summary and any compliance materials up front.
3) We’ll put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) with success criteria for pilot (latency goals, end-to-end traceability, sample app).

Karthik, Vanessa — can you help scope the engineering touchpoints (SDK surface, trace formats we need to support, sandbox key flow)? I’ve looped you in.

Jordan Blake
Head of Ecosystem, Redwood Inference
Attachments: (none)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 15:27:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Integration proposal: ToolingWorks + Redwood toolchain adapter

Internal notes / plan (do not forward):

Summary: ToolingWorks wants an adapter + tracing integration. Potential value: packaged partner integration for ISVs and customers who want unified observability.

Immediate asks from me:
- Karthik: audit our current SDK extension points and list the minimal surface for a shim (auth, streaming, function-calls). Estimate: 3–4 engineer days to produce a prototype.
- Vanessa: partner GTM — draft a 1-pager and 2 pilot criteria (customer success involvement, target customers).
- Jordan: confirm pilot success metrics and whether we want to offer an official connector in the marketplace.

Timeline (target):
- Week 1: Intro call + security docs exchanged
- Week 2: Prototype adapter and sandbox test keys; run sample trace (internal)
- Week 3: Demo to 1 pilot customer + finalize MAP

I’ll own logistics for the kickoff and MAP doc.

Marissa Cole
Director, Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
From: Ethan Zhou <ethan@toolingworks.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration proposal: ToolingWorks + Redwood toolchain adapter

Thanks — good plan. Attaching the following: TW-SOC2-summary.pdf and ToolingWorks-API-spec-v1.yaml.

Answers to a couple of quick questions:
- Sandbox keys: we can issue time-limited sandbox API keys for Redwood test tenants; please provide redirect/callbacks if needed.
- Trace format: we support OpenTelemetry spans and can add a mapping layer to emit Redwood request IDs in span attributes.
- Example app: we’ll share a small Next.js sample that uses our SDK + traces through your runtime.

Proposed kickoff: Tue 13 Jul, 10:00am PT — confirmed on our side. I’ll include Asha Patel (security) on the kickoff to walk compliance materials.

Ethan
Asha Patel (cc: asha@toolingworks.com)
Attachments: TW-SOC2-summary.pdf, ToolingWorks-API-spec-v1.yaml
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Zhou <ethan@toolingworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Asha Patel <asha@toolingworks.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration proposal: ToolingWorks + Redwood toolchain adapter

Great — thanks for the materials, Ethan and Asha. Looking forward to Tuesday’s call. To make the kickoff efficient, I’ve attached a short Mutual Action Plan and the items we’ll want to cover on the call:

Kickoff agenda (30m):
- Introductions + objectives (5m)
- Security/compliance overview (Asha) (7m)
- Technical scope: SDK adapter surface, trace propagation (Karthik) (8m)
- Pilot logistics & timeline (Marissa) (5m)
- Next steps / owners (5m)

Mutual Action Plan (attached): mutual-action-plan-TW-redwood.docx — high-level success criteria:
- Pilot passes end-to-end trace verification with sample app (target: <500ms added latency for adapter)
- Sandbox test suite runs with Redwood test tokens and generates trace links in Redwood Console
- Security checklist items reviewed and accepted by both teams

Karthik: please confirm you can allocate 1 engineer for Week 2 prototype (estimate: 3–4 days). Vanessa: I’ll sync with you on marketplace listing language once pilot completes.

See you on Tue.

Jordan Blake
Head of Ecosystem, Redwood Inference
Attachments: mutual-action-plan-TW-redwood.docx
